name: Dante's Wrath
source:
A story of friendship, loss, and a talking Llama. Follow Dante and his best friend, Ringo the llama and discover Dante's link to a ruthless villain named Gen. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240225173058/http://renai.us/game/dwrath.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
